title: Normalize architecture and development documentation
status_detail: Planned fourth child; blocked on root navigation, separate explicit activation required, and no automatic successor activation.
objective: Make architecture and development documentation semantically organized and editable without coupling page topology to harness Task projections.
authorized_scope: Retain architecture v1, v2, migration, and compiler pages as ordinary human-authored documentation with descriptive navigation.
Replace architecture Task completion rules based on exact page counts with semantic criteria for implemented, target, and migration ownership.
Classify development and harness guidance as current guidance or history and repair links without changing durable Task or scientific authority.
completion_criteria: Architecture and development indexes expose current pages clearly, page additions do not require Task page-count changes, and the compiler architecture is directly readable from the repository.
Current guidance and historical material are distinguishable by location and page status, with no duplicate architecture authority.
Links and the warnings-as-errors Sphinx build pass without ordinary prose changes requiring harness synchronization.
exclusions: Do not implement Architecture v2, alter scientific execution status, change dependencies, create ADRs, or activate a successor automatically.
Do not rewrite historical decisions or remove retained records merely because their filenames are inconvenient.
